papers.title: On the machining of selective laser melting CoCrFeMnNi high-entropy alloy
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory for Precision and Non-traditional Machining Technology of Ministry of Education, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian 116024, China

corresponding_authors.name: Jiang Guo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory for Precision and Non-traditional Machining Technology of Ministry of Education, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian 116024, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究高熵合金的切削加工性，与生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳性能或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, stress shielding, fatigue, osseointegration, or porous structures for stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究增材制造高熵合金的切削加工性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验测量切削力、表面质量和刀具磨损。
summary_zh.result: SLM制备的CoCrFeMnNi合金具有良好的可加工性。
summary_zh.validation: 切削实验对比不同工艺参数下的加工表现。

summary_en.motivation: The study investigates the machinability of additively manufactured high-entropy alloys to understand cutting behavior.
summary_en.method: Cutting forces, surface roughness, and tool wear were experimentally measured using cemented carbide tools under various cutting parameters.
summary_en.result: The selective laser melted CoCrFeMnNi alloy exhibited favorable machinability with acceptable surface quality.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed through systematic cutting tests with parameter variation.

papers.title: The clinical impact of edoxaban for the patients with postoperative anemia after total hip arthroplasty

papers.venue: European Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery & Traumatology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是关于全髋关节置换术后贫血患者使用依度沙班的临床研究，与髋关节植入物生物力学、有限元分析或应力遮挡等研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a purely clinical study on anticoagulation therapy for postoperative anemia, with no biomechanical modeling, implant design, FEA, or quantification of stress shielding or micromotion.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估依度沙班对全髋关节置换术后贫血患者的影响
summary_zh.method: 临床回顾性研究，分析依度沙班使用与贫血关系
summary_zh.result: 依度沙班可能增加术后贫血风险

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the clinical impact of edoxaban on postoperative anemia in patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective clinical study analyzing the association between edoxaban administration and hemoglobin levels post-surgery.
summary_en.result: Edoxaban use was associated with a higher incidence of postoperative anemia.
summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis of clinical patient data.

papers.title: Uncertainty quantification in multiscale simulation of woven fiber composites
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Northwestern University, Evanston, IL 60208, United States

corresponding_authors.name: Wei Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Northwestern University, Evanston, IL 60208, United States

papers.venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文的多尺度不确定量化方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中，但未涉及生物医学应用。
llm.why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; no FEA surrogate model for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化编织复合材料多尺度模拟中的不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 提出多尺度不确定量化框架，结合随机降阶模型。
summary_zh.result: 有效传播微观不确定性至宏观响应，计算成本降低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证方法精度与效率。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify uncertainties in multiscale simulations of woven fiber composites for reliable performance predictions.
summary_en.method: A multiscale uncertainty quantification framework integrating stochastic reduced-order models is proposed.
summary_en.result: Micro-scale uncertainties are efficiently propagated to macro-scale responses with reduced computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Numerical case studies demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

papers.title: Physico-mechanical and Surface Wear Assessment of Magnesium Oxide Filled Ceramic Composites for Hip Implant Application
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, MNIT Jaipur, Jaipur, 302017, India

corresponding_authors.name: Chandramani Goswami
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, MNIT Jaipur, Jaipur, 302017, India

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究用于髋关节植入物的陶瓷复合材料，但未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA of femoral stem, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no intact vs implanted comparison.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发用于髋关节植入物的氧化镁填充陶瓷复合材料。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同MgO含量的陶瓷复合材料并进行物理力学和磨损测试。
summary_zh.result: 添加MgO提高了复合材料的硬度和耐磨性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过硬度、密度、孔隙率和磨损实验验证材料性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop magnesium oxide filled ceramic composites with improved mechanical and wear properties for hip implant applications.
summary_en.method: Ceramic composites with varying MgO content were fabricated and characterized for physical, mechanical, and wear properties.
summary_en.result: MgO addition enhanced hardness and wear resistance of the composites.
summary_en.validation: Validation through experimental measurements of density, porosity, hardness, and wear rate.
